Package hadur2.core.melee

Class MeleeController

java.lang.Object
hadur2.core.melee.MeleeController
public class MeleeController extends Object
Runs Hadur's melee subsystems for one tick and returns what the robot should do. HadurCore hands it every event and, while two or more opponents are alive, asks it for the tick's orders. What it learns about each opponent (OpponentStatsBook) lasts the whole battle; everything else is per round.

    • MeleeController

      public MeleeController(BattleField field)

    • MeleeController

      public MeleeController(BattleField field, EnemyTracker world)
      A melee brain reading world, the core's one model of the field (A3, WORLD-1). The core feeds the World before it offers the melee an event, so the scanned, bulletHit, hitByBullet and died handlers below leave it alone; the on... handlers feed it themselves, for a melee brain on its own.

      public MeleeProfileFolder profiles()
      This round's observations for the melee profile blocks (MMEM-1). Unlike the rest of the per-round state it is not cleared by newRound(), which the core also calls to recover from a fault mid-round; the core clears it when a round starts.
